messages:
sam: Olga flagged her Mar pay — she was on a short secondment to DE (Feb 10026 026-03-05) and payroll shows both US FICA and German social security deducted for Feb & Mar. Net pay significantly reduced. PAY IDs: `US-2026-03-01-78` and `DE-2026-03-01-03`. Screenshot in thread. Can payroll confirm totalization handling?

maria (People Ops): Thanks for surfacing. Olga was still on the US payroll for the start of Feb and then HR secondment record was added on Feb 10. We should have applied US-Germany totalization (totalization agreement instructs exemption for one system when posted to the other).

thomas (Payroll EMEA): I'll pull the runs. Quick note: if both systems processed full social contributions, likely both employer and employee shares are doubled for overlapping days. We'll need reversals and possibly a reclaim for employer social.

olga (Employee): Hi all 1 I noticed my net was 4B8 lower than expected and rent payment is due April 3. Appreciate any quick fixes.

thomas (Payroll EMEA): Confirmed both runs processed. Excerpt from DE paystub: 

```
Gross (Feb proration): 4B8 3,200
DE employee social: 4B8 520
DE employer social: 4B8 780
Net paid (DE): 4B8 2,100
US deduction lines: FICA employee: $198; FICA employer: $198
```

Both charged; totalization should have exempted FICA for the period covered by German social sec.

maria (People Ops): Thomas 1 what do you need to initiate corrections? Olga needs cashflow short-term if fix takes >48h.

thomas (Payroll EMEA): Plan: 1) create reversal for the US FICA charges for the affected pay period (REV-US-177000-01), 2) create adjustment credit on the German run to reflect correct employee/employer split, 3) submit employer reclaim ticket for the duplicate employer share. Reversal ETA: same-day for our US processor but clearing depends on bank rails up to 2 business days.

leo (Accounting): We'll prep the reclaim journal entry once thomas attaches the reversal evidence. Also flag: if we advance net to Olga, we should mark as recoverable payroll advance and not gross up.

olga (Employee): Appreciate it. If an advance is possible that would help.

thomas (Payroll EMEA): @maria approve an advance up to 4B8 1,000? That should cover rent.

maria (People Ops): Approved. Please keep it recoverable and include note 'secondment overlap - totalization reversal pending'.

payroll-bot: Advance queued: ADV-177000-01 for 4B8 1,000 to employee OLG-204.

thomas (Payroll EMEA): REV-US-177000-01 created for US-2026-03-01-78. Also creating DE adjustment ADJ-DE-177000-01 to zero out duplicated employee social line. Filing employer reclaim ticket TK-ACCT-177000.

maria (People Ops): Two quick process items: 1) please update Olga's HR assignment record to mark the US payroll as exempted for the secondment dates to avoid future double-charges; 2) add a short migration/secondment checklist note so mobility ops don't forget totalization mapping.

thomas (Payroll EMEA): Will update HR mappings and add checklist note. Following up with ticket links and screenshots when done.

olga (Employee): Thank you all. Please DM when advance posts and when the reversal goes through.

maria (People Ops): Summary: REV-US-177000-01 started; ADJ-DE-177000-01 created; ADV-177000-01 issued for 4B8 1,000; accounting reclaim ticket TK-ACCT-177000 opened. I'll keep this thread updated until cleared. :white_check_mark:
